headline: Historic Breakthrough! Personal Housing Loan Terms Extended to a Maximum of 40 Years, Development Loans Reformed in Parallel
summary: China has extended the maximum term of personal housing loans to 40 years, with development loans reformed in parallel. The move was announced as a historic breakthrough in mortgage policy.
why: Mortgage tenor and lending rules shape household borrowing capacity and demand in the property market, which is a major part of China's economy. Developers and banks are directly exposed to these changes.
